name: drawer-boxes
description: Twelve drawer boxes for a tool chest: 12mm ply sides and ends, 6mm ply bottoms. Two materials, so the solver must split this into two fully independent packing runs and never mix them on a sheet - a 12mm part on a 6mm sheet would be a real cut, made wrong. Every part is interior and invisible, so all may turn. Hand-checked layouts on usable 2430 x 1210: the 12mm sheets take five 238mm rows each (1202 of 1210), filled from 23,184mm of part length against 24,300mm of row; the 6mm sheet takes three 400mm rows of [bottom x 4] = 2153. Three sheets, 9.8% waste at a perfect pack.
